units.source_text: 老师就是这样把钱交到我的手里，我也比老师更明白，这是他对我的一种虚伪的信赖。

en.t: In this way, the teacher placed the money in my hands, and I understood even better than he did that this was a kind of false trust he showed toward me.

units.source_text: 老师无言中踢给我的恩惠里，存在他那柔软的桃红色的肌肉似的东西。

en.t: Within the favor the teacher silently kicked over to me, there existed something like his soft, peach-pink flesh.

units.source_text: 人世间充满虚伪的肉体，有以信赖对待背叛和以背叛对待信赖的肉体，

en.t: The human world is filled with false bodies, bodies that meet betrayal with trust and meet trust with betrayal,

units.source_text: 还有不受任何腐败所侵蚀的肉体，悄然地繁殖于温馨、淡桃色的肉体……

en.t: and also bodies untouched by any corruption, quietly multiplying within warm, pale peach-colored flesh...
